description: A year of parties for one client — lineup boards, day bills and teasers: Ohm 2.Ω, the After After Party, Phantom Halloween, Christmas.
story: Event design is scene reportage: Anjuna cliff, 3 AM onwards, no masks no entry. Across a full calendar the system flexed — grunge type over red-orange artwork for the festival, nebulae for the after-hours, a wreath for Christmas — while the sponsor rows, venue line and lineup typography held formation. The posters carry the colour; the identity carries the year.
